build_commit: unchanged since block A (no deploy or reload); machine deck (real Steam Deck)
screen: Deck's own screen: Quick Access page window 854 x 454; Steam page 854 x 534
setup: Search tab. For each page a word was put in the Search tab's find box by my own script (scratchpad driverC2/deck_send_search.py): same method as deck_send_ask.py (native value setter plus bubbling input event, read back after 0.5 s) but aimed at input[aria-label='Search for a word']. Every write printed VERIFIED with the read-back equal to the word. Never pressed A on the box. The ring was kept on the tab bar when the word went in.
pressed: Per page: type word; Down x6 from the tab bar (All games, find box, word row 1, word row 2, Clear, first result), read focus (aria label), then A as its own step on the Settings row of the named page; wait 2 s; read the Steam page (the heading after the Settings list); B; GUIDE+A chord to reopen Quick Access (B from a Steam page goes to Steam Home and closes Quick Access, the ring comes back on the Search tab bar with the same word and results).
